title: Soil–Air Thermal Contrasts and Seasonal Water-Use Efficiency in Northern Hemisphere Vegetation
description: Research code and supporting data accompanying the manuscript Soil–Air Thermal Contrasts and Seasonal Water-Use Efficiency in Northern Hemisphere Vegetation, submitted to Journal of Geophysical Research: Atmospheres. This archive includes reproducible analysis code, spatial-block model inputs, statistical results, figure-source tables, and dataset documentation for Northern Hemisphere vegetation during 2001–2024. Original satellite, reanalysis, and flux-tower observations are available from their respective providers.
